items.title: Blake Corum: Efficient with eight touches
items.body_text: Corum rushed five times for 19 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 53 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Davante Adams: Two TDs in OT loss
items.body_text: Adams brought in five of seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kyren Williams: Rush TD on inefficient night
items.body_text: Williams rushed 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown and brought in six of eight targets for 27 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Massive yardage total in OT loss
items.body_text: Stafford completed 40 of 54 passes for 383 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Allen: Late-game heroics in OT win
items.body_text: Allen completed 12 of 19 passes for 210 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding 10 carries for 121 yards and another score and a two-point conversion pass in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on Monday night.
